meta.title: NBA official betting and prediction-market policy — what is confirmed and what is not
meta.rule: Official value columns are only filled when read from an official NBA page. Anything from a secondary outlet is marked unverified with the official value left blank.

rows.item: Official prediction-market framework (Kalshi and Polymarket as Preferred Exchanges; CFTC MOU; integrity obligations)
rows.official_statement_verified: Release dated Oct 26, 2026 says the agreements include 'limitations on permissible markets, affirmative prohibitions on trading NBA event contracts by league and team personnel, and information-sharing obligations', and that partner markets include 'market restrictions aligned with the NBA's latest sports betting restrictions'.

rows.item: Official NBA gaming partners and operators list (dated July 9, 2026)
rows.official_statement_verified: Domestic official gaming partners: DraftKings, FanDuel. The list covers US, Canadian and international partners by country (Australia, Greece & Cyprus, France, Germany, Mexico, Philippines, Serbia, Spain, Uruguay). No South Korea or Brazil entry appears on the list. Re-read 2026-11-05; the page itself is dated July 9, 2026.

rows.item: Restriction: sportsbooks may not offer 'under' props on players expected to log fewer than 12 minutes per game
rows.secondary_reports_unverified: Reported as a 2026-27 restriction on under bets for bench players expected to play under 12 minutes per game.

rows.item: Restriction: no 'first of' props (opening tip winner; first shot, rebound, assist, steal, or block) and no bets against those outcomes
rows.secondary_reports_unverified: Reported as banned, including the opening-tip winner and whether a specific player gets the first shot, rebound, assist, or steal.

rows.item: Restriction: no parlays combining 'under' props for the same player
rows.secondary_reports_unverified: Reported as a ban on parlays that group under props on a single player's statistics.

rows.item: Restriction: 'alternate under' customization and 'low likelihood, high payout' parlays
rows.secondary_reports_unverified: Reported as banning customized alternate-under numbers and parlaying single-player unders the league calls 'low likelihood, high payout'.

rows.item: The NBA memo to sportsbooks and the league memo to teams (primary documents)
rows.secondary_reports_unverified: Reported by ESPN, TSN, and others as having been sent to partners. The primary text was not found on an official NBA page.
